title: Cardinal Personal Auto Policy Status Reference: Notices of Cancellation, Rescission and Reinstatement
content:
The status of a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy follows the notices that govern it.

## Status movements

| From | To | When |
|---|---|---|
| Bound | In force | The term effective date arrives |
| In force | Cancel pending | Billing mails a notice of cancellation for nonpayment, or the company mails an underwriting cancellation notice on new business |
| Cancel pending | In force (notice rescinded) | Billing records the cure before the cancellation effective date |
| Cancel pending | Cancelled | The cancellation effective date passes without a cure |
| Cancelled | In force (reinstated) | The policy's Cardinal Billing Account is reinstated under the billing reinstatement rules |

## Underwriting cancellation of new business

An underwriting cancellation is possible only within the package's new business underwriting period, in calendar days after the inception date (60 days on every package). It is possible only on the ground of a material misstatement of a driver or vehicle fact: the application misstated a driver or vehicle fact that would have made the package unavailable.

## Reinstatement

- A cancelled policy is reinstated only when its Cardinal Billing Account is reinstated under the billing reinstatement rules.
- Reinstatement restores the term with a lapse from the cancellation effective date to the reinstatement date, unless billing reinstates without lapse.
- Reinstatement writes back, as additional premium, the return premium credited at cancellation.
- A policy cancelled at the insured's request, or flat cancelled, cannot be reinstated; the customer applies for new business.
- **Condition on the record.** A cancelled policy is reinstated only when its billing account status is current again after a billing reinstatement. The status is read from the billing account linked to that policy.

| How the policy was cancelled | Billing account status | Reinstatement of the policy |
|---|---|---|
| Nonpayment or underwriting notice | Current again after a billing reinstatement | Reinstated; lapse unless billing reinstates without lapse |
| Nonpayment or underwriting notice | Not current | Not reinstated |
| At the insured's request, or flat | any | Not reinstatable; new business application |

Hypothetical: a policy cancelled for nonpayment whose billing account was reinstated with a lapse is reinstated with a lapse from the cancellation effective date to the reinstatement date. The return premium credited when it was cancelled is written back as additional premium.
